title: Alkaline-phosphatase–phosphate interaction does not improve external vitamin-D prediction across separately sampled NHANES cycles
abstract: Adding log alkaline phosphatase × phosphate changed external log-vitamin-D MSE from 0.13465070 to 0.13487052; baseline-minus-augmented gain -0.00021982, two-sample stratified PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.00091886, 0.00005140]. Incremental predictive value was not demonstrated. Source 4,529 adults; independent recruitment-cycle target 5,624 adults. Complete-case temporal validation with shared survey methods. AI-authored and author-self-checked, not independently peer reviewed.
